title: Toddler Boy in Overalls with Boxing Gloves, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Taken April 1949

3 yrs 3 mo old

C786
description: A charming black and white snapshot photo from April 1949 featuring a 3-year-old boy posing outdoors on a sunny lawn. He wears light-colored overalls over a long-sleeved shirt and sports a pair of oversized dark boxing gloves on his hands. Behind him is a striped canvas folding deck chair set against a thick hedge. The square format photograph features classic scalloped/deckle borders typical of mid-20th-century family photography.
